ImageColorSpace.name: ImageColorSpace
ImageColorSpace.description: Convert sRGB, linear Rec.709, HDR (Rec.2020 HLG), and HDR PQ (Rec.2020 PQ). Linear 1.0 uses the same 203-nit reference white as sRGB; HLG uses a 1000-nit reference display. Linear output and linear-to-HDR conversions preserve extended values without tone mapping. SelectModelDevice.name: SelectModelDevice
SelectModelDevice.description:
Place the diffusion model on a specific device (default / cpu / gpu:N).

- "default" restores the device assigned by the loader (even after a
  prior Select Model Device call).
- "cpu" pins both the load and offload device to CPU.
- "gpu:N" pins the load device to the Nth available GPU; the offload
  device is restored to the loader's original choice.

When the requested device differs from the device the input model is
already on, a fresh model is spawned via the loader's reload factory
(cached_patcher_init) so the new patcher owns independent weights on
the new device. Loaders that don't support multigpu (no factory) will
cause the node to pass through unchanged with a warning.

If the workflow already has MultiGPU CFG Split applied and the chosen
GPU collides with one of the existing multigpu clones, that clone is
dropped so two patchers don't end up bound to the same device.

When the selected device does not exist on the current machine
(e.g. a workflow built on a 2-GPU box opened on a 1-GPU box),
the node passes the model through unchanged and logs a message
instead of failing.

NOTE: Placing Select Model Device *after* a node that has already
consumed the same model (e.g. a KSampler that ran on this model on
the original device) is not recommended -- any state the prior
consumer mutated on the original model will be observed when the
selected device matches the original (fast path). Place Select Model
Device before any consumer of the model.

SelectCLIPDevice.name: SelectCLIPDevice
SelectCLIPDevice.description:
Place the CLIP text encoder on a specific device (default / cpu / gpu:N).

- "default" restores the device assigned by the loader.
- "cpu" pins both the load and offload device to CPU.
- "gpu:N" pins the load device to the Nth available GPU.

When the selected device does not exist on the current machine
(e.g. a workflow built on a 2-GPU box opened on a 1-GPU box),
the node passes the CLIP through unchanged and logs a message
instead of failing.

SelectVAEDevice.name: SelectVAEDevice
SelectVAEDevice.description:
Place the VAE on a specific device (default / gpu:N).

- "default" restores the device assigned by the loader.
- "gpu:N" pins the load device to the Nth available GPU; the offload
  device is set to the standard VAE offload device.

CPU is intentionally not exposed in the UI for the VAE; if a workflow
supplies "cpu" anyway (e.g. opened from another machine), the request
is dropped with a log message and the VAE is passed through unchanged.

When the selected device does not exist on the current machine
(e.g. a workflow built on a 2-GPU box opened on a 1-GPU box),
the node passes the VAE through unchanged and logs a message
instead of failing.

selection.tooltip: Method used to choose key blocks for full token-level attention. sol-attn: Sparsifying Online Attention uses a training-free adaptive threshold for each attention head and query block. sla: Sparse-Linear Attention keeps a fixed percentage of the highest-scoring key blocks; use only with model weights trained for this pattern. vsa: Video Sparse Attention (FastVideo) uses 3D video-cube tiling and a learned coarse attention branch; requires FastH3 model weights.

tau.tooltip: Threshold in score-distribution sigmas. Higher is sparser: 1.0 keeps ~16% of key blocks exact, 1.5 ~7%, 2.0 ~2.7%.

start_percent.tooltip: Percentage point when sparse attention begins. Before this point, attention stays dense.

end_percent.tooltip: Percentage point when sparse attention ends. After this point, attention returns to dense.

dense_blocks.tooltip: Transformer blocks that always run dense, e.g. '0, 1, 47-49'.

min_tokens.tooltip: Sequences shorter than this stay dense.

extra_tokens.tooltip: Extra top-scoring tokens each query block attends beyond its selected blocks. Closer to dense for more attention time; 256 recommended, 0 disables. Ignored for VSA.

sink_conditioning.tooltip: MiniMax-H3 only. exact_kv: every query attends the packed text/audio/reference rows exactly (~3% cost). exact_kv_and_rows: additionally runs the target-audio query rows dense (keeps generated audio intact).

verbose.tooltip: Logs whether each attention shape used sparse attention or why it stayed dense.

weld_epsilon_rel.tooltip: Pre-weld tolerance (fraction of bounding box diagonal); boundary detection needs welded vertices. 0 skips.

max_vertices.tooltip: Cap boundary vertices per cycle; centroid-fan only works for small near-planar holes. Keep ≤16.

fill_chains.tooltip: Also fill open chains (not just cycles). Noisy; OFF matches cumesh.

FillHoles.name: FillHoles
FillHoles.description: Fills holes up to a max perimeter, preserving existing geometry/UVs. GPU-vectorised with auto-corrected winding and loop-averaged centroid colors

epsilon_rel.tooltip: Weld tolerance (fraction of bbox diagonal). 1e-5 for float dedup; 1e-3 for visibly-close-but-distinct verts.

WeldVertices.name: WeldVertices
WeldVertices.description: Merge coincident vertices via L_inf grid quantization. Use when a mesh comes in unwelded (per-face verts, no shared edges) — pre-pass before FillHoles, DecimateMesh, or any topology-aware op. Colors averaged per cluster.

line_quadric_weight.tooltip: Per-edge line-quadric weight; preserves sharp ridges/valleys. 0 = off.

feature_edge_quadric_weight.tooltip: Extra quadric weight on dihedral feature edges (creases). 0 = off.

feature_edge_min_dihedral_deg.tooltip: Minimum dihedral angle (degree) to count an edge as a feature edge.

clamp_v_to_edge.tooltip: Project the QEM-optimal position onto the collapsed edge segment.

DecimateMesh.name: DecimateMesh
DecimateMesh.description: Simplifies a mesh to a target face count using QEM, on the active compute device. 'midpoint' is the cumesh-faithful preset (best quality, preserves thin features / hair); 'qem' places vertices at the QEM optimum with line/feature-edge controls. Output stays welded.

resolution.tooltip: Voxel grid resolution (output density). 256 ~ 100k faces, 512 ~ 1M. For an exact face count, follow with Decimate Mesh.

sign_mode.tooltip: udf: robust to messy/non-manifold input. sdf: clean single surface with QEF (Quadratic Error Function) sharp-feature recovery, but needs consistent winding.

qef.tooltip: QEF (Quadratic Error Function) dual-vertex placement for sharper edges.

drop_inverted_components.tooltip: Drop inward-normal (negative-volume) closed components — the UDF inner shell.

drop_enclosed_components.tooltip: Drop components inside the largest's bbox that fail a point-in-mesh raycast. Disable for legitimate nested parts.

qef.tooltip: QEF (Quadratic Error Function) dual-vertex placement (recovers sharp features) vs edge-crossing centroid.

manifold.tooltip: Manifold Dual Contouring: 1-4 dual verts/voxel for multi-sheet cases. Slower.

band.tooltip: Narrow-band width in voxel units. In UDF mode also offsets the surface.

project_back.tooltip: Linearly interpolate vertices toward the original surface (0 = pure DC, 1 = snapped).

fix_poles.tooltip: Collapse valence-3 vertex pairs (DC T-junction artifact).

smooth_iters.tooltip: Taubin smoothing iterations (0 = off). 2-3 cleans DC staircase-like artifacts; higher over-smooth QEF edges.

drop_small_components.tooltip: Drop components below this fraction of the largest's face count. 0 disables.

precluster_max_verts.tooltip: Cap input vertex count before the field queries, inputs above this are cluster-decimated to it first. Prevents OOM on huge meshes.

RemeshMesh.name: RemeshMesh
RemeshMesh.description: Re-extracts a uniformly tessellated mesh via a narrow-band distance field + Dual Contouring, on the active compute device. Normalizes messy / non-manifold / self-intersecting topology; run before Decimate Mesh to hit an exact face count. Output stays welded.

segmenter.tooltip: pec: fast parallel-edge-collapse charting on GPU. adaptive: CPU, slower.

resolution.tooltip: Target atlas resolution for texel-density auto-scale (0 = fit-to-content).

weld_distance.tooltip: Coincident-vert merge radius as a fraction of mesh extent (0 = auto). Raise to ~0.001 if you get per-triangle charts (unwelded input).

UnwrapMesh.name: UnwrapMesh
UnwrapMesh.description: Generates a UV atlas: segments the surface into charts, parameterizes each, packs into a [0,1] atlas. Vertices on chart seams are duplicated (one copy per chart, same position, own UV), so the output mesh has more vertices than the input. Run after Remesh/Decimate, before texture baking.

RenderUVAtlas.name: RenderUVAtlas
RenderUVAtlas.description: Renders a mesh's UV layout as an image.

PaintMesh.name: PaintMesh
PaintMesh.description: Paints each mesh vertex with its nearest voxel color from the input voxel field.

reference_mesh.tooltip: Optional dense pre-decimation mesh; back-projects each texel onto its true surface before sampling, removing faceted baking on coarse meshes.

BakeTextureFromVoxel.name: BakeTextureFromVoxel
BakeTextureFromVoxel.description: Bakes PBR textures onto the mesh's existing UV layout (trilinear-sample the sparse voxel volume). Does NOT unwrap — connect a UV unwrap node upstream. Outputs base_color + metallic/roughness grayscale IMAGEs (black if no PBR); feed them to ApplyTextureToMesh (SAME mesh) for SaveGLB.

MeshTextureToImage.name: MeshTextureToImage
MeshTextureToImage.description: Extracts a mesh's baked textures as individual IMAGEs: base_color, metallic, roughness, occlusion and normal_map. Channels with nothing baked come back neutral (occlusion white, normal flat).

ApplyTextureToMesh.name: ApplyTextureToMesh
ApplyTextureToMesh.description: Attaches baked texture IMAGEs to a mesh's UV layout for SaveGLB. Feed the SAME mesh you baked

cage_distance.tooltip: Surface search band, as a fraction of the bounding box diagonal. Raise for wrong/missing patches under heavy decimation; lower if it grabs across gaps.

ignore_backfaces.tooltip: Skip high-poly surfaces facing away from the texel, so crevices/enclosed spaces don't grab the opposite wall. Disable only if the high-poly winding is inconsistent.

BakeNormalMapFromMesh.name: BakeNormalMapFromMesh
BakeNormalMapFromMesh.description: Bakes a tangent-space normal map (glTF/OpenGL +Y) from a high-poly mesh into a low-poly's UV layout, capturing detail lost during decimation. Feed the UV-unwrapped low_poly and the high_poly it was decimated from. Outputs an image for Apply Texture To Mesh's normal_map input.

samples.tooltip: Rays per texel. More = smoother, slower. Raise if grainy.

max_distance.tooltip: Ray length, as a fraction of the bounding box diagonal. Smaller = tighter, more local occlusion.

bias.tooltip: Ray origin lift off the surface, as a fraction of the bounding box diagonal. Raise if even surfaces show dark blotches/holes.

BakeAmbientOcclusion.name: BakeAmbientOcclusion
BakeAmbientOcclusion.description: Bakes an ambient-occlusion map from a high-poly mesh into a low-poly's UV layout (white = open, dark = crevices). Feed the UV-unwrapped low_poly and the high_poly it was decimated from. Outputs a grayscale image for Apply Texture To Mesh's occlusion input (packed into the ORM map / occlusionTexture).

mode.tooltip: What to render. auto: texture if present, else vertex colours, else shaded clay.

model_3d_info.tooltip: Model transform from the same Load3D / Preview3D viewer. Connect it with camera_info to match the viewer framing.

camera_info.tooltip: Camera from a Load3D / Preview3D viewer or a Create Camera Info node. If none is connected, a default front view is auto-framed.

RenderMesh.name: RenderMesh
RenderMesh.description: Ray-casts a single view of a mesh. The camera and optional model transform can come from a Load3D / Preview3D viewer.

crease_angle.tooltip: Edges whose dihedral angle exceeds this value (degrees) stay hard (vertices are split). 180 = fully smooth; lower preserves sharp edges (e.g. ~30-60 for hard-surface).

MeshSmoothNormals.name: MeshSmoothNormals
MeshSmoothNormals.description: Compute smooth per-vertex normals and attach them to the mesh. Meshes without normals are shaded flat (per-face) by glTF viewers; this makes them shade smoothly. With crease_angle below 180, edges sharper than the threshold are kept hard by splitting vertices along them.

bboxes.tooltip: Optional bounding boxes for more accurate detections. Required for multi-person detection.

output_tooltips: Keypoints in OpenPose frame format (canvas_width, canvas_height, people)
SDPoseKeypointExtractor.name: SDPoseKeypointExtractor
SDPoseKeypointExtractor.description: Extract pose keypoints from images using the SDPose model: https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/SDPose/tree/main/checkpoints

scale.tooltip: Multiplier for the bounding box area around each detected face.

force_square.tooltip: Expand the shorter bbox axis so the crop region is always square.

output_tooltips: Face bounding boxes per frame, compatible with SDPoseKeypointExtractor bboxes input.
SDPoseFaceBBoxes.name: SDPoseFaceBBoxes

output_width.tooltip: Width each crop is resized to.

output_height.tooltip: Height each crop is resized to.

padding.tooltip: Extra padding in pixels added on each side of the bbox before cropping.

keep_aspect.tooltip: Whether to stretch the crop to fit the output size, or pad with black pixels to preserve aspect ratio.

output_tooltips: All crops stacked into a single image batch.
CropByBBoxes.name: CropByBBoxes
CropByBBoxes.description: Crop and resize regions from the input image batch based on provided bounding boxes.

image.tooltip: Optional base image to paint over

layers.tooltip: Layer stack to composite; build it with Add Layer. Items are stacked by z_index, batch frames inside an item expand to consecutive layers, and item placement, opacity, and blend mode define the initial composition. Without an explicit document canvas the size is a best-effort maximum extent of the placed layers. A saved composition that matches the current inputs takes priority.

compositor.tooltip: Layered composition saved by the compositor editor.

output_tooltips: Composited image. Carries an alpha channel when the composite has transparent areas (e.g. hidden background), otherwise plain RGB.
Transparency of the composite (1 = fully transparent). All zeros when the composite is opaque.
ImageCompositor.name: ImageCompositor

image.tooltip: Layer content at its native size. A batch expands to consecutive layers.

layers.tooltip: Layer stack to append to. Leave unconnected to start a new stack.

mask.tooltip: Transparency mask for this layer. Masked areas (value 1) become transparent, multiplying with any alpha channel the image already carries.

name.tooltip: Layer name shown in the compositor editor.

x.tooltip: Initial horizontal placement on the canvas.

y.tooltip: Initial vertical placement on the canvas.

blend_mode.tooltip: Initial blend mode, applied against the layers below. On the bottom layer over the default transparent background, non-normal modes produce transparency.

width.tooltip: Initial display width. 0 keeps the image's native width.

height.tooltip: Initial display height. 0 keeps the image's native height.

z_index.tooltip: Stacking override. Layers are stable-sorted by z_index; equal values keep their list order.

output_tooltips: The layer stack with this layer appended.
AddLayer.name: AddLayer

image.tooltip: Image batch; each frame becomes one layer.

bboxes.tooltip: Placement boxes, index-aligned with the image batch. Accepts bounding boxes (x, y, width, height), normalized elements (with a 'bbox' - these need canvas_width/canvas_height to resolve to pixels), or a JSON string of either. Frames without a matching box are placed at the origin. A box's width/height scales the layer to fit it. metadata.name (or desc) and metadata.z_index are used when present, and metadata.content_rect (frame-relative) crops the frame to its real content.

mask.tooltip: Per-frame transparency, index-aligned with the image batch (1 = transparent, LoadImage convention).

layers.tooltip: Layer stack to append to. Leave unconnected to start a new stack.

crop_to_content.tooltip: Crop each frame to metadata.content_rect where present and place the content at the box position plus the rect offset. Leave on for batches whose frames are padded - it keeps only the real content at its true spot.

canvas_width.tooltip: Document canvas width. 0 derives it from the placed layers.

canvas_height.tooltip: Document canvas height. 0 derives it from the placed layers.

output_tooltips: The layer stack, ready for Create Layered Image.
LayersFromBoundingBoxes.name: LayersFromBoundingBoxes
LayersFromBoundingBoxes.description: Turn an image batch plus its bounding boxes into a layer stack, one layer per frame, each placed by its own box. Use this when a node emits layers as a batch - a batch carries a single placement for every frame, so the individual positions are otherwise lost.

bg_removal_name.tooltip: The model used to remove backgrounds from images

bg_removal_model.tooltip: Background removal model used to generate the mask

image.tooltip: Input image to remove the background from

output_tooltips: Generated foreground mask
RemoveBackground.name: RemoveBackground
RemoveBackground.description: Generates a foreground mask to remove the background from an image using a background removal model.

class_name.tooltip: Filter detections by class. Set to 'all' to disable filtering.

max_detections.tooltip: Maximum number of detections to return per image. In order of descending confidence score.

model_name.tooltip: Select a frame interpolation model to load. Models must be placed in the 'frame_interpolation' folder.

refine_iterations.tooltip: SAM decoder refinement passes (0=use raw detector masks)

individual_masks.tooltip: Output per-object masks instead of union

positive_coords.tooltip: Positive point prompts as JSON [{"x": int, "y": int}, ...] (pixel coords)

negative_coords.tooltip: Negative point prompts as JSON [{"x": int, "y": int}, ...] (pixel coords)

max_objects.tooltip: Max tracked objects. Initial masks count toward this limit. 0 uses the internal cap of 64.

detect_interval.tooltip: Run detection every N frames (1=every frame). Higher values save compute.

initial_mask.tooltip: Mask(s) for the first frame to track (one per object)

conditioning.tooltip: Text conditioning for detecting new objects during tracking

object_indices.tooltip: Comma-separated object indices to include (e.g. '0,2,3'). Empty = all objects.

pose_start.tooltip: Start step of the pose conditioning.

pose_end.tooltip: End step of the pose conditioning.

video_frame_offset.tooltip: Cumulative output frame this chunk begins at. Wire from the previous chunk's video_frame_offset output.

previous_frame_count.tooltip: Tail frames of previous_frames to anchor. SCAIL-2 trained at 5 (81-frame chunks, 76-frame step).

pose_video.tooltip: Video used for pose conditioning. Will be downscaled to half the resolution of the main video.

pose_video_mask.tooltip: SCAIL-2 only. Colored per-identity SAM3 mask video at the same resolution as pose_video.

replacement_mode.tooltip: SCAIL-2 only. False = Animation Mode (pose_video_mask should have black background). True = Replacement Mode (pose_video_mask should have white background).

reference_image.tooltip: Reference image. The first image is the primary reference (composite all identities onto it). SCAIL-2: extra batch images are used as additional views (back view, close-up, occluded background), each needing a matching reference_image_mask in that identity's color.

reference_image_mask.tooltip: SCAIL-2 only. Colored reference mask, batch matching reference_image (first = primary reference mask, rest = identity masks for the additional reference_image).

clip_vision_output.tooltip: CLIP vision features for conditioning. Model is trained with stretch resize to aspect ratio.

previous_frames.tooltip: SCAIL-2 only. Full decoded output of the previous chunk. Only the last previous_frame_count are used as the extension anchor.

output_tooltips: Empty latent of the generation size.
Adjusted offset + length. Wire into the next chunk.
WanSCAILToVideo.name: WanSCAILToVideo

driving_track_data.tooltip: SAM3 track of the driving pose video. Will be rendered into the pose_video_mask output.

object_indices.tooltip: Comma-separated list of person indices to include (e.g. '0,2,3'). Applied to both reference and pose video masks. Empty = all.

sort_by.tooltip: Order in which palette colors are assigned to the tracked objects (applied to both reference and pose video so each identity keeps the same color). Objects that appear in earlier frames always come first; within a frame, left_to_right = leftmost object (by centroid at first appearance) gets the first color, area = biggest object (by mask area at first appearance) gets the first color; none = keep SAM3's order.

replacement_mode.tooltip: False = Animation Mode (pose_video_mask has black background, reference_image_mask has white background). True = Replacement Mode (pose_video_mask has white background, reference_image_mask has black background).

ref_track_data.tooltip: SAM3 track of the reference image(s) (one identity per object, colored in batch order), or a plain MASK of the reference subject (rendered as a single identity).

model_name.tooltip: Optical flow model to load.  Files must be placed in the 'optical_flow' folder.  Today only torchvision's raft_large.pth is supported.

dilate_width.tooltip: Dilation radius for the primary mask region (0 = no dilation)

quadmask.tooltip: Preprocessed quadmask from VOIDQuadmaskPreprocess [T, H, W]

length.tooltip: Number of pixel frames to process. For CogVideoX-Fun-V1.5 (patch_size_t=2), latent_t must be even — lengths that produce odd latent_t are rounded down (e.g. 49 → 45).

video.tooltip: Pass 1 output video frames [T, H, W, 3]

length.tooltip: Number of pixel frames. Rounded down to make latent_t even (patch_size_t=2 requirement), e.g. 49 → 45.
The number of frames in the generated video. Should stay 149 for WanDancer.

clip_vision_output.tooltip: The CLIP vision embeds for the first frame.

clip_vision_output_ref.tooltip: The CLIP vision embeds for the reference image.

start_image.tooltip: The initial image(s) to be encoded, can be any number of frames.

mask.tooltip: Image conditioning mask for the start image(s). White is kept, black is generated. Used for the local generations.

output_tooltips: Empty latent.
WanDancerVideo.name: WanDancerVideo

audio_inject_scale.tooltip: The scale for the audio features when injected into the video model.

output_tooltips: The calculated fps based on the audio length and the number of video frames. Used in the prompt.
WanDancerEncodeAudio.name: WanDancerEncodeAudio

segment_index.tooltip: Which segment this is (0 for first, 1 for second, etc.)

audio.tooltip: Audio to calculate total output frames from and extract segment audio.

output_tooltips: Padded keyframe sequence
Mask indicating valid frames
Audio segment for this video segment

num_segments.tooltip: How many padded segments to emit as lists.

audio.tooltip: Audio to slice for each emitted segment.

Audio segment for each video segment

EmptyHiDreamO1LatentImage.name: EmptyHiDreamO1LatentImage
EmptyHiDreamO1LatentImage.description: Empty pixel-space latent for HiDream-O1-Image. The model was trained at ~4 megapixels; lower resolutions go off-distribution and quality regresses noticeably. Trained resolutions: 2048x2048, 2304x1728, 1728x2304, 2560x1440, 1440x2560, 2496x1664, 1664x2496, 3104x1312, 1312x3104, 2304x1792, 1792x2304.

images.tooltip: Reference images are used in numeric socket order.

HiDreamO1ReferenceImages.name: HiDreamO1ReferenceImages
HiDreamO1ReferenceImages.description: Attach ordered reference images to positive and negative conditioning.

start_percent.tooltip: Sampling progress (0=start, 1=end) at which the blend turns ON.

end_percent.tooltip: Sampling progress at which the blend turns OFF.

pattern.tooltip: Shift layout. single_shift: one pass at the natural patch grid + others offset. symmetric: all passes off-grid, shifts split around origin.

passes.tooltip: Number of passes per gated step. 2/4 = fixed. ramp_*: pass count increases as sampling approaches end (more smoothing where seams are most visible).

blend.tooltip: average: equal-weight mean. window: Hann-windowed weighting favoring each pass away from its patch boundaries. median: per-pixel median, rejects wraparound-outlier passes.

strength.tooltip: Interpolation between the natural-grid pred (0) and the averaged result (1).

HiDreamO1PatchSeamSmoothing.name: HiDreamO1PatchSeamSmoothing
HiDreamO1PatchSeamSmoothing.description: Average the model output across multiple shifted patch-grid positions during the late portion of sampling. Cancels seams.

MeshToFile3D.name: MeshToFile3D
MeshToFile3D.description: Serialize a mesh to a GLB File3D object for Save / Preview 3D nodes, carrying its UVs, colors, normals, texture, normal/occlusion/emissive maps and material. Supports one item per batch only.

angle_x.tooltip: Rotation around the X axis in degrees.

angle_y.tooltip: Rotation around the Y axis in degrees.

angle_z.tooltip: Rotation around the Z axis in degrees.

RotateMesh.name: RotateMesh
RotateMesh.description: Rotate a mesh. Euler XYZ applies X then Y then Z about the world axes (degrees). Quaternion is (w, x, y, z), auto-normalized.

MergeMeshes.name: MergeMeshes
MergeMeshes.description: Concatenate N meshes into one by offsetting face indices and stacking verts, faces, uvs, and colors.

model_3d.tooltip: 3D model file from an upstream 3D node.

width.tooltip: Render width of the viewport in pixels.

height.tooltip: Render height of the viewport in pixels.

model_3d_info.tooltip: Placement of each model in the scene: position, rotation, and scale (Y-up world space).

camera_info.tooltip: Viewport camera information: position, look-at target, zoom, and type.

output_tooltips: 3D model file (glb/obj/stl/etc.) from an upstream 3D node.
Placement of each model in the scene: position, rotation, and scale (Y-up world space).
Viewport camera information: position, look-at target, zoom, and type.
Render width of the viewport in pixels.
Render height of the viewport in pixels.
Save3DAdvanced.name: Save3DAdvanced

model_3d.tooltip: 3D model file from Load 3D or another 3D node. FBX/USDZ are not supported - convert to GLB first.

Get3DComponents.name: Get3DComponents
Get3DComponents.description: Parse a 3D model file (GLB, GLTF, OBJ, STL) into an editable MESH for the mesh-processing nodes (decimate, remesh, UV unwrap, bake, ...). All scene nodes/primitives are merged into one mesh with their transforms applied; textures and material factors come from the first material. Counterpart of MeshToFile3D.

fov_x_degrees.tooltip: Horizontal field of view of the source camera. Sets the focal length used to unproject the depth map into 3D. 0 = auto-recover from the predicted points.

batch_size.tooltip: Images per inference call. Lower if you OOM on a long video / image set.

apply_mask.tooltip: Set masked-out (sky / invalid) pixels to inf in points and depth so meshing culls them. Disable to keep the raw predicted geometry everywhere; the mask is still returned separately.

refine_steps.tooltip: MoGe-3 only: sparse volumetric refinement passes over the predicted depth. More passes sharpen fine detail and edges at a roughly linear cost. 0 disables refinement. Ignored by MoGe-1 / MoGe-2.

MoGeInference.name: MoGeInference
MoGeInference.description: Run MoGe on a single image to estimate depth and geometry.

merge_resolution.tooltip: Long-side resolution of the merged equirect distance map.

batch_size.tooltip: Views per inference batch (12 splits total).

refine_steps.tooltip: MoGe-3 only: sparse volumetric refinement passes over the predicted depth. More passes sharpen fine detail and edges at a roughly linear cost. 0 disables refinement. Ignored by MoGe-1 / MoGe-2.

MoGePanoramaInference.name: MoGePanoramaInference
MoGePanoramaInference.description: Run MoGe on an equirectangular panorama by splitting it into 12 perspective views, running inference on each, and merging the results into a single depth map.

output.tooltip: DirectX vs OpenGL controls the normal-map green-channel convention. DirectX: green = -Y down (Unreal). OpenGL: green = +Y up (Blender, Substance, Unity, glTF).

MoGeRender.name: MoGeRender
MoGeRender.description: Render a depth map or normal map from geometry data

batch_index.tooltip: Which image of a batched MoGe geometry to mesh. Per-image vertex counts differ, so batches can't be stacked into a single MESH.

discontinuity_threshold.tooltip: Drop pixels whose 3x3 depth span exceeds this fraction. 0 = off.

texture.tooltip: Carry the source image through as the baseColor texture.

MoGePointMapToMesh.name: MoGePointMapToMesh
MoGePointMapToMesh.display_name: Convert MoGe Point Map to Mesh
MoGePointMapToMesh.description: Convert a MoGe point map into a 3D mesh.

MoGeGeometryToFOV.name: MoGeGeometryToFOV
MoGeGeometryToFOV.description: Derive the field of view and focal length from MoGe intrinsics.

detector_variant.tooltip: Face detector range. 'short' is tuned for close-up faces (within ~2 m of the camera); 'full' covers farther / smaller faces (up to ~5 m) but is slower. 'both' runs both detectors and keeps whichever found more faces per frame (~2× detection cost).

num_faces.tooltip: Maximum faces to return per frame. 0 = no cap (return all detected).

min_confidence.tooltip: BlazeFace score threshold. Lower to catch small/occluded faces.

missing_frame_fallback.tooltip: Per-frame behaviour when detection fails in a batch. 'empty' leaves the frame faceless. 'previous' copies the most recent successful detection. 'interpolate' lerps landmarks/bbox/blendshapes between bracketing successful frames. Multi-face: pairs faces across frames by greedy bbox-centre NN.

MediaPipeFaceLandmarker.name: MediaPipeFaceLandmarker
MediaPipeFaceLandmarker.description: Detects facial landmarks using MediaPipe model.

connections.tooltip: 'all' = oval+eyes+brows+lips+irises+nose. 'fill' = solid face_oval polygon (silhouette mask). 'custom' = toggle each feature individually (including 'tesselation', the full 2547-edge wireframe).

thickness.tooltip: Edge line thickness in pixels. 0 disables edge drawing.

point_size.tooltip: Landmark dot radius in pixels. 0 disables point drawing.

image.tooltip: If not connected, a black canvas will be used.

MediaPipeFaceMeshVisualize.name: MediaPipeFaceMeshVisualize
MediaPipeFaceMeshVisualize.description: Draws face landmarks mesh on the input image.

regions.tooltip: 'all' = union of face_oval+lips+eyes+irises (which collapses to face_oval since it encloses the rest). 'custom' = toggle each region individually for combos like lips+eyes.

face_oval.tooltip: Include the 'face_oval' region in the mask.

lips.tooltip: Include the 'lips' region in the mask.

left_eye.tooltip: Include the 'left_eye' region in the mask.

right_eye.tooltip: Include the 'right_eye' region in the mask.

irises.tooltip: Include the 'irises' region in the mask.

MediaPipeFaceMask.name: MediaPipeFaceMask
MediaPipeFaceMask.description: Draws a mask from face landmarks.

format.tooltip: ply: standard 3D Gaussian Splat with full spherical harmonics. ksplat: mkkellogg SplatBuffer (level 0, uncompressed), base color only spz: Niantic gzip-compressed (~10x smaller), base color only

SplatToFile3D.name: SplatToFile3D
SplatToFile3D.description: Serialize a gaussian splat to a File3D object for Save / Preview 3D nodes. Supports one item per batch only.

File3DToSplat.name: File3DToSplat
File3DToSplat.description: Parse a splat File3D into a gaussian splat. Inverse of Create 3D File (from Splat). Supported format:  PLY, SPLAT, KSPLAT, SPZ. PLY carries full spherical harmonics, the other formats are base color only. Format is auto-detected from the file contents.

frames.tooltip: -1, 0, 1 = single still image; >1 = turntable, the camera orbits over a full 360 turn (works with any camera_info). Negative value orbits the other way.

splat_scale.tooltip: Multiplier on each splat's projected footprint (lower = crisper points, higher = softer/fuller surface).

sharpen.tooltip: Sharpen overlapping splats: 1.0 = physically-correct blend; higher biases each pixel toward its dominant (nearest) splat for crisper texture, without shrinking splats or opening gaps. Non-physical above 1.

headlight_shading.tooltip: Diffuse shading from a light at the camera (headlight), using the splat surfel normals: darkens surfaces that turn away from view to reveal form/curvature. 0 = flat albedo, 1 = strongest shading.

opacity_threshold.tooltip: Cull gaussians with opacity below this (removes faint floaters).

render_style.tooltip: What the image output shows: color, clay (neutral-albedo shaded), depth (near=bright), normal (OpenGL normal map).

bg_image.tooltip: Optional background plate composited behind the splat (overrides the solid background colour). Resized to the render size; a batch is used per frame, a single image for all. color/clay only.

camera_info.tooltip: Camera to render from - a Load3D / Preview3D camera or a Create Camera Info node. If empty, the splat is auto-framed from a default 3/4 view.

RenderSplat.name: RenderSplat
RenderSplat.description: Render a gaussian splat as an image with an anisotropic EWA rasterizer (oriented elliptical splats, antialiased, depth-sorted front-to-back). The camera comes from a camera_info input (Load / Preview 3D, or a Create Camera Info node); leave it empty to auto-frame the splat. Set frames greater than 1 for a turntable batch of images to feed a Video node.

mode.tooltip: How to define the camera: orbit angles, an explicit position, or a position + quaternion.

position_x.tooltip: Camera position in world space (right-handed, Y-up).
Camera position in world space (right-handed, Y-up).

quat_w.tooltip: Camera world-rotation quaternion (three.js: looks down local -Z). Normalized for you.

target_x.tooltip: Look-at point (orbit pivot / aim). In orbit mode, move it to pan/translate the whole camera. Ignored in quaternion mode. Defaults to the origin.

roll.tooltip: Camera roll about the view axis, degrees.

fov.tooltip: Vertical field of view in degrees.

zoom.tooltip: Digital zoom (focal-length multiplier). >1 zooms in without moving the camera.

camera_type.tooltip: Projection used by Render Splat: perspective (foreshortening) or orthographic (parallel).

CreateCameraInfo.name: CreateCameraInfo
CreateCameraInfo.description: Build a camera_infoMode 'orbit' aims with yaw/pitch/distance around the target; 'look_at' places the camera at world position. Coordinates are the viewer's world space (right-handed,Y-up).

TransformSplat.name: TransformSplat
TransformSplat.description: Translate, rotate, and scale a gaussian splat. Non-uniform scale also reshapes every individual splat, slower process.

GetSplatCount.name: GetSplatCount
GetSplatCount.description: Returns the number of splats summed across the batch.

MergeSplat.name: MergeSplat
MergeSplat.description: Concatenate any number of gaussian splats into one. Unioning several decodes of the same latent at different seeds densifies the surface, this can improve surface quality when meshing.

resolution.tooltip: Density-grid resolution along the longest axis. Higher = finer surface, more VRAM/time (grows with resolution^3).

kernel.tooltip: Max splat half-width in voxels. Each gaussian is rasterized over a window sized to its own 3-sigma, capped here - small surfels stay cheap, large ones aren't truncated. Raise if sparse splats leave gaps.

smooth.tooltip: Taubin mesh-smoothing iterations. Smooths the surface without shrinking it (volume-preserving), unlike blurring the density. 0 = raw surface.

level.tooltip: Iso-surface level. Auto-picked by Otsu; this biases it (1.0 = auto, lower = fatter/more-connected surface, higher = thinner/tighter).

min_component.tooltip: Drop connected components smaller than this many vertices (0 = keep all). Removes detached floater blobs and the inner shell of the double wall.

min_opacity.tooltip: Ignore gaussians fainter than this before meshing.

color_sharpen.tooltip: Crisp up the vertex texture: 1.0 = physically-correct blend; higher biases each voxel's colour toward its dominant gaussian instead of averaging neighbours (de-smears the texture). Colour only - geometry is unchanged.

SplatToMesh.name: SplatToMesh
SplatToMesh.description: Extract a coloured mesh from a gaussian splat.

erode_radius.tooltip: Erode the alpha matte by this pixel radius before cropping (avoids border bleed).

size.tooltip: Square image size. The model is trained at 1024; other sizes run but are off-distribution.

TripoSplatPreprocessImage.name: TripoSplatPreprocessImage
TripoSplatPreprocessImage.description: Crop center each image to a square canvas on a black background and add padding.

output_tooltips: The fixed size noise target (latent +camera).
TripoSplatConditioning.name: TripoSplatConditioning
TripoSplatConditioning.description: Encode the image with DINOv3 and the Flux2 VAE into TripoSplat positive/negative conditioning, and create the fixed size noise target (latent + camera) for the KSampler

num_gaussians.tooltip: Number of gaussians to produce (rounded to a multiple of 32). 262144 matches the octree's point density; higher oversamples the same points (denser, but no new detail) and costs proportionally more VRAM/time.

seed.tooltip: Seeds the octree point sampler (global RNG) for deterministic decodes.

VAEDecodeTripoSplat.name: VAEDecodeTripoSplat
VAEDecodeTripoSplat.description: Decode the sampled TripoSplat latent into a 3D gaussian splat. Modify the number of gaussians to vary the density.

octree_level.tooltip: Octree depth for the preview decode (lower = cheaper/coarser).

num_gaussians.tooltip: Number of gaussians to produce for the preview (rounded to a multiple of 32).

point_size.tooltip: Maximum splat radius in pixels. Each gaussian is sized from its scale and capped here; lower = finer/pointier, higher = chunkier.

TripoSplatSamplingPreview.name: TripoSplatSamplingPreview
TripoSplatSamplingPreview.description: Patch the TripoSplat model for the standard Ksampler node to show a live decoded gaussian splat preview at each step.

resolution.tooltip:
Resolution the model runs at (longest side, multiple of 14).
Lower = faster / less VRAM.
Higher = more detail.
Output is upsampled back to the original size.

resize_method.tooltip:
upper_bound_resize: scale so the longest side = resolution (caps memory, default).
lower_bound_resize: scale so the shortest side = resolution (preserves more detail on tall/wide images, uses more memory).

mode.tooltip:
mono: single view image (works with any model variant).
multiview: all images processed together for geometric consistency + camera pose (for Small/Base models only).

ref_view_strategy.tooltip:
Which view acts as the geometric anchor.
- saddle_balanced: the view most 'average' across all others (best general choice).
- saddle_sim_range: the view most visually distinct from the others.
- first / middle: fixed positional picks.

pose_method.tooltip:
How the camera field-of-view is estimated (for Small/Base models only).
- cam_dec: learned from image features.
- ray_pose: derived geometrically from the model's 3D ray output.
Affects perspective correctness of the 3D output. Try both if results look distorted.

output_tooltips:
Dictionary of non-normalized tensors.
Always has the keys: depth, image, mode.
Optional keys: sky (for Mono/Metric), confidence (for Small/Base), extrinsics + intrinsics (for multi-view).
DA3Inference.name: DA3Inference
DA3Inference.description: Run Depth Anything 3 on an image. In multi-view mode each image is treated as a separate view of the same scene.

output.tooltip:
- depth: normalised greyscale depth image.
- depth_colored: depth mapped through the Turbo colormap.
- sky_mask: sky probability in [0, 1] (for Mono/Metric models only).
- confidence: normalised depth confidence (for Small/Base models only).

normalization.tooltip:
- v2_style: mean/std normalisation for perceptually balanced results (default).
